fixes: Tapping a failed download now opens a sheet that says what went wrong, what to do about it, and that your downloaded progress is safe — with Resume and Delete right there.
Downloads that were running when the app closed now say they're resuming from the progress you already have, instead of looking like they started over.
The download status now shows the segment count and an ETA, so a long download reads as moving.
The 'Download complete' notification now shows the episode poster, and tapping it opens the finished episode.
Completed downloads are grouped by title, and each title has a 'Delete all' that asks first and shows how many episodes it will remove.
